mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_MESSAGE ( MESSAGE_KEY, ROOM_KEY, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENDER_USER_KEY, MESSAGE_CONTENT, FILE_KEY ) VALUES ( #{messageKey}, #{roomKey}, #{messageType}, #{senderUserKey}, #{messageContent}, #{fileKey} )
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_KEY AS messageKey, ROOM_KEY AS roomKey, MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType, SENDER_USER_KEY AS senderUserKey, MESSAGE_CONTENT AS messageContent, FILE_KEY AS fileKey, CREATED_AT AS createdAt, DELETED_YN AS deletedYn FROM TB_CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_KEY = #{roomKey} AND DELETED_YN = 'N' ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CHAT_ROOM_MST SET LAST_MESSAGE_KEY = #{messageKey}, LAST_MESSAGE_CONTENT = #{messageContent}, LAST_MESSAGE_AT = NOW() WHERE ROOM_KEY = #{roomKey}
